facts.fact: ch04 第一节主角 Valerio 七岁，住在儿童之家，梦里的朋友比现实多
facts.anchor: Valerio has many friends in the world of dreams, while in that of flesh he’s lonely

facts.fact: Sister Babette 说做梦伤身、现实会一拳打脸，Valerio 的回应是：停止反抗才会被打晕
facts.anchor: At seven Valerio has already been punched frequently, and has learned that it certainly is bad for you, but it only knocks you out when you stop fighting

facts.fact: Valerio 住在儿童之家，床硬、饭淡
facts.anchor: The bed in the children’s home is hard (orthopaedic) and the food at dinner is insipid (healthy)

facts.fact: 有人（Valerio 熟识）在梦中呼喊去岛，他辨向之后飞去
facts.anchor: To the Island! someone he knows well is calling to him

facts.fact: 第二节 Michele 热爱走路，走路时问题落在身后
facts.anchor: Putting one foot in front of the other, he moves aimlessly, and his problems fall behind him

facts.fact: Michele 这次出门不是散步：患阿尔茨海默的父亲从家里跑了
facts.anchor: Papa has run away from home

facts.fact: Stefano 忘记怎么冲马桶，但三天前证明自己还会点烟——病让他不可预测
facts.anchor: Papa doesn’t remember how to flush a toilet, sometimes not even what a toilet is, but three days ago he demonstrated he could light a cigarette

facts.fact: Michele 住在 Corso Trieste 与 Viale Libia 之间的体面住宅区
facts.anchor: Michele lives in a quiet residential street, between Corso Trieste and Viale Libia

facts.fact: Michele 在 Corso Trieste 附近找到穿酒红睡裤拖鞋游走的父亲，形同活死人
facts.anchor: He looks like a zombie in slippers and burgundy pyjamas, and in a sense, he is—one of the walking dead

facts.fact: 小中风发展为大中风，与 Michele 一起长大，吞噬 Stefano 的大脑；Michele 为此怀有负罪感
facts.anchor: Then the strokes got bigger, along with Michele, destroying larger and larger portions of Stefano’s brain—as if his youngest son was a monster feeding on his father’s life

facts.fact: 父亲在一根路灯杆前停下细看，Michele 判定为异常行为
facts.anchor: this is unusual behaviour

facts.fact: 第三节：罗马中央图书馆号称知识连接器，实际像地狱一环，馆员粗野规则荒诞
facts.anchor: In practice, it’s more like a circle of hell: rude staff, surreal rules, disappearing books make every trip to the library a Dantesque adventure

facts.fact: Giovanni 为研究近两年泡在这座图书馆
facts.anchor: Giovanni has been in the library for most of the last two years

facts.fact: Giovanni 两天前从市集摊买了旧的 Weaveworld，读到入迷
facts.anchor: an old Clive Barker novel: Weaveworld

facts.fact: 织入地毯的诸世界的故事给他比拳台更甚的愉悦眩晕
facts.anchor: they give him a pleasurable vertigo, more intense than he feels in the boxing ring, just as good as sex

facts.fact: 导师 Stranieri（绰号 Fatty）劝他别再玩、要长大做严肃的事
facts.anchor: the time for that stuff is over. You’re not ten years old any more

facts.fact: Luisa 每天坚持要 Giovanni 做自己、别屈服
facts.anchor: Fortunately his girlfriend insists every day that he must remain himself

facts.fact: Giovanni 的线索：1947 年英国精神分析师 Peter DuQuette 的小册子
facts.anchor: It’s a booklet from 1947 by an English psychoanalyst, Peter DuQuette

facts.fact: DuQuette 翻了数十万页笔记后确认孩子们梦里的岛有共同特征：美人鱼、海盗、武士
facts.anchor: he realised that all the islands the children dreamed of had similar characteristics

facts.fact: 岛之梦在十一二岁消失；成人续梦者都被诊断为重性精神障碍
facts.anchor: at eleven, twelve years old, they stop

facts.fact: Giovanni 猜想成年后同样的欲望换成别的梦（如热带假期）
facts.anchor: Maybe in adults the same desires manifest with other dreams—I don’t know, a tropical vacation

facts.fact: Giovanni 的假说：梦退场之处，传说进场补位
facts.anchor: And maybe—I stress maybe because there are no more dreams—the legend starts

facts.fact: Giovanni 没能把册子借出来：先还再等上架再换表重约，耗两小时而馆要闭馆
facts.anchor: the library was closing

facts.fact: 图书馆明天与周六特别清扫，要周一才能再去
facts.anchor: The library’s closed for special cleaning tomorrow and Saturday. So not till Monday

facts.fact: 叙述者判定：这是 Giovanni 与 Luisa 旧生活的最后一个夜晚
facts.anchor: It’s the last evening of their old life

facts.fact: 第五节 Wendy 在 Parioli 派对开场前检查暗袋、松紧与假底
facts.anchor: She checks that all the pockets are free, the elastics in place, the false bottoms securely stitched and ready

facts.fact: Wendy 在厨房听见：寿星的一个朋友几天前在 San Basilio 被杀
facts.anchor: the Wondrous Wendy heard that a friend of the birthday girl was killed a few nights ago in San Basilio

facts.fact: Wendy 的心法：魔术不是藏起手法，而是让你看别处
facts.anchor: The magician’s skill is not about hiding the trick, but making you look elsewhere

facts.fact: Wendy 对第一位观众耳语施压：你背着女友和辩论社的 Simonetta 在一起
facts.anchor: You’re cheating on your girlfriend with Simonetta from debate club

facts.fact: 所谓「我有短信照片」纯属诓——作者点破她的心理术底牌
facts.anchor: that was the oldest trick in the world, plain bullshit told with flair

facts.fact: 礼帽里钻出一只巴掌大的小白兔，全场首次真心喝彩
facts.anchor: Out of the top hat peeps a little rabbit—a soft baby no bigger than a hand

facts.fact: 章末反转：Wendy 知道那顶帽子里原本没有兔子，因而感到从未有过的恐惧
facts.anchor: Because, she knows, there was no rabbit in that hat
